CRPF and Officials Honor Police Martyrs on Commemoration Day

On Police Commemoration Day, the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) paid homage to martyrs at GC Humhama. In Adilabad, the Collector and Superintendent of Police assured support to the families of police martyrs.
